home.contractTitle: There is a new version of the contract
home.contractIntro: Please read and accept it to keep using Ao Lume. Among other things, the contract says that the service, food safety and licences are your responsibility, and that this acceptance counts as your signature.
home.termsIntro: Please read the updated terms and accept them to keep using Ao Lume.

money.title: Money
money.awaitingDeposit: {count, plural, one {# booking is} other {# bookings are}} waiting for the deposit.
money.restToConfirm: {count, plural, one {# booking needs} other {# bookings need}} you to confirm whether the client has paid you the rest.

onboarding.title: Create your chef profile
onboarding.description: Three steps, about ten minutes. You can stop whenever you like: whatever you save stays saved, and you come back here when you sign in.
onboarding.missingDishes: {count, plural, one {# dish photo} other {# dish photos}}
onboarding.legalIntro: Before your profile goes for review, we need your acceptance. Among other things, the contract says that the service, food safety and licences are your responsibility.

offers.title: Menus, boxes and orders
offers.description: Fixed price, per person or on request. Each offer says where it is served: at the client's home, delivered or picked up.
offers.openDaysNote: You have {count, plural, one {# open day} other {# open days}} in Availability: clients can already request this offer on those days.
offers.noOpenDaysNote: Now open the days you can cook, in Availability. Clients can only request a booking on open days.
offers.empty: You don't have any offers yet. Create your first: a menu, a box, an order. Then open the days you can cook, in Availability.

form.title: Title
form.visible: Visible on your profile and in search

slots.none: With no times chosen, clients can request 13:00 or 20:00.
slots.chosen: {count, plural, one {# time chosen} other {# times chosen}}: {list}.

confirmIban.title: Confirm your new IBAN
confirmIban.incomplete: This link is incomplete. Open the email we sent you and press the confirmation button, or <link>request the change again</link>.
confirmIban.done: Done: we'll now pay you into the new account. For security, payments are held for 72 hours and the team checks the account before the first transfer.

reviews.title: What your clients say
reviews.description: Only clients with a completed booking can leave a review. You can reply once to each review, and report abusive ones: the team decides.
reviews.empty: No reviews yet. The review request is sent 24 hours after each completed booking.

reply.label: Public reply (you can only reply once)

requests.title: Requests
requests.summary: {toAnswer} to answer · {count, plural, one {# booking scheduled} other {# bookings scheduled}}
requests.toAnswerEmpty: No new requests. When a client sends one, it shows up here and you get an email.
requests.toCompleteHint: Mark it as completed: the client gets the review request.

row.needsQuote: On request · your price is missing

actions.confirmsItself: The booking confirms itself as soon as the deposit comes in. You don't need to do anything.
actions.completableFrom: You can mark it as completed from {date}
actions.confirmCancel: Cancel this booking? The client will be notified.
actions.declinePlaceholder: I already have an event that day
actions.quoteIntro: The client is waiting for your price. Check the request notes and enter the total price for the service. If the client accepts, they pay the deposit in the app and the date is secured.

contact.title: Contact
contact.greeting: {hasName, select, yes {Hello {name}!} other {Hello!}} I'm from Ao Lume{hasRef, select, yes {, about booking {ref}} other {}}.

money.title: Money
money.estimated: Estimated price: {amount}. The amounts are fixed when you accept the request.
money.toQuote: Price still to be quoted. The amounts are fixed when you accept the request.
money.depositPaid: Deposit paid {when}. We transfer it once the service is completed.
money.transferAfter: We transfer it once the client has paid and the service is completed.
money.notReceived: I haven't received it after all
money.howMuchHint: Just for your own records. We don't charge or transfer it.
money.clientPaidRest: The client has paid me the rest

agenda.title: Availability
agenda.description: The days you take requests. Clients only see and request open days.
agenda.noDaysTitle: You haven't opened any days yet.
agenda.noDaysText: Choose your regular days, which stay open every week, or tap each day in the calendar.
agenda.noOffersToo: Remember to create an offer too, in Offers.
agenda.openCount: {count, plural, one {# open day} other {# open days}}
agenda.green: Green: open day, clients can request a booking.
agenda.white: White: closed day, no one can request.
agenda.blue: Blue: you already have a booking that day.
agenda.tapHint: Tap a day to open or close it; it's saved straight away. Closing a regular day closes only that day, and opening another day opens only that one.
agenda.weeklyText: The days of the week you usually cook. They stay open every week, with no end date.
agenda.weeklySummary: Open every week: {days}. For a day off or holidays, close that day in the calendar.
agenda.noWeekly: No regular days yet: only the days you open in the calendar are open.

day.freeDayText: No services booked. You can close this day in Availability.

settings.radiusNote: You're shown to clients up to {km} km from {area}. Travel and arrival time are agreed with each client.
settings.pickupNote: The address is agreed with the client when the order is ready. Each pick-up has a 4-digit code to confirm the handover.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: The client pays the deposit in the app. After each completed service, we transfer that deposit to you minus our commission.
payments.missingText: Without your tax details, a verified IBAN and the accepted contract we can't transfer anything to you. The money waits for you; it isn't lost.
payments.empty: No payments yet. They appear here after your first completed service.

documents.title: Documents
documents.empty: No documents yet. You get one with each payment.
documents.intro: Keep them for your accounts: each one shows what you received and what was kept as commission.

billing.title: Invoicing and payments
billing.description: The client pays the deposit in the app. Once the service is completed, we transfer that deposit to you minus our commission, with a document that explains the calculation.

steps.ibanPending: There's a change waiting for confirmation in your email.
steps.ibanVerifiedNote: We check new accounts before the first payment.

billing.missing: {count, plural, =0 {You're all set to get paid} one {One thing left} other {# things left}}
billing.onHold: Payments are held for security after the IBAN change. They go back to normal automatically.
billing.blocked: Your payments are suspended. Get in touch so we can sort it out.
billing.blockedWithReason: Your payments are suspended ({reason}). Get in touch so we can sort it out.

form.title: Your tax details
form.intro: These are the details shown on the document you receive with each payment. Only you and our team can see them.
form.nifHint: Nine digits. We check the control digit.
form.vatHint: If in doubt, it's the one your accountant chose when you registered your activity.
form.dac7Text: Since we started handling payments, we're required to report these details to the Portuguese Tax Authority once a year, along with the amounts you received. We always tell you what was reported.

iban.requested: We've sent you an email to confirm. Your current account doesn't change until then.
iban.title: Where you get paid
iban.intro: The account we transfer your money to after each service. We store it encrypted and never show it in full.
iban.pendingChange: There's a change waiting for confirmation (account ending in {last4}). Open the link we sent you by email. Until you confirm, we keep paying into the current account.
iban.invalid: This doesn't check out yet. Check the digits.
iban.holderHint: Must be the account holder, as registered with the bank.
iban.bicHint: Optional. Only for accounts outside Portugal.
iban.security: For security: we email you to confirm the change, we notify the previous address, and payments are held for 72 hours after the change.

agreement.accepted: Contract accepted. We've emailed you a copy.
agreement.title: Contract
agreement.commission: Current commission: {percent}% of the booking value, with a minimum of {min}, deducted from the deposit. We transfer the rest to you once the service is completed.
agreement.outdated: The contract has changed since you accepted it (you had version {version}). Read and accept the new version so we can keep paying you.
agreement.consent: I have read and accept the Payment Intermediation Contract.

legal.title: Terms and contract
legal.success: Acceptance recorded. We've emailed you a copy.
legal.acceptBoth: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms and Conditions</terms> and the <contract>Payment Intermediation Contract</contract>.
legal.acceptTerms: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms and Conditions</terms>.
legal.acceptContract: I have read and accept the <contract>Payment Intermediation Contract</contract>.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.createDescription: Start with the essentials. Once you've saved, upload your photos and send it for review.
profile.photosText: Your face and your food: it's what clients see first.
profile.cookingText: What you cook and how you work. It appears on your profile and is used as a search filter.
profile.needSocial: Add your Instagram or website. One is enough, and it's only so the team can see your work before approving you.
profile.areaNotFound: We couldn't find that area. Type the neighbourhood and the city, for example "Alvalade, Lisboa".

form.appearHint: With a verified certificate, you'll appear as Chef.
form.headline: A line for your profile
form.headlineHint: Shown under your name. Up to 80 characters.
form.headlinePlaceholder: Alentejo cooking for dinners at home
form.bioPlaceholder: Your story, what you cook, how you work.
form.areaHint: Clients see the area, never your address.
form.depositHint: The client pays it in the app. Minimum {min}%.
form.depositHintNoMin: The client pays it in the app to confirm the booking.
form.languagesHint: Shown on your profile, for clients who speak other languages.

verification.sent: Sent for review. We'll reply by email.
verification.title: Verification
verification.intro: A profile photo, a verification selfie (private), your Instagram or website, and at least three dish photos. The team compares the selfie with the profile photo before the profile goes public.
verification.saveFirst: Save your profile first; then upload the photos.
verification.terms: By sending, you accept the terms for chefs: you're responsible for the legality, hygiene, taxes and payments of your service.

submit.title: Send for review
submit.intro: The team compares the selfie with your profile photo and looks at your dishes. We reply by email, usually on the same working day. After that, your profile appears in search.

services.home: Cooks and serves at the client's home
services.delivery: Takes the food to the client's address
services.pickup: The client collects from your kitchen

cooking.chooseUpTo: Choose up to {max}. Clients filter their search by these categories.
cooking.notListed: Is your cuisine not on the list?
cooking.addHint: It's selected straight away if you have fewer than five. Then save your changes.
cooking.previewNote: Changes appear in search as soon as you save.

title.statementSent: Thank you! The team will read your description and reply by email.
title.verifiedText: The team has confirmed your title. Clients see you as Chef {name}, with the “Verified chef” badge.
title.title: Chef title
title.intro: You currently appear as {current}. To become Chef {name}, with the “Verified chef” badge, send a certificate (cookery course, hospitality school, professional diploma). Don't have one? Tell us about your experience: years cooking, where you've cooked, whether you teach. The team reads every request.
title.modeLabel: How you want to request the title
title.experienceHint: Only the Ao Lume team reads this. It doesn't appear on your profile.
title.experiencePlaceholder: I've been cooking for 20 years, I was a cook at the restaurant… Today I teach cookery at…
title.fileHint: PDF, JPG or PNG up to 10 MB. Only the Ao Lume team can open it.

upload.fileType: Use a PDF, JPG or PNG.
upload.tooBig: The file is larger than 10 MB.
upload.demo: Demo mode: the certificate isn't saved.
upload.failed: We couldn't upload the file. Please try again.
upload.sent: Certificate sent. The team will reply by email.

photos.portraitText: A photo of you, with your face visible. It's the one clients see on your public profile.

selfieSteps.take: Take a selfie now, facing the camera, with your face clearly visible and good light. No sunglasses or filters.
selfieSteps.compare: The team compares it with your profile photo to confirm it's the same person.
selfieSteps.retake: If it isn't clear, we'll ask you for another by email. You can replace it here whenever you like.
selfieSteps.deleted: When your profile is approved, the selfie is deleted. It isn't kept.

photos.private: Private · only the team sees it
photos.selfieDeleted: Your identity has been confirmed and the selfie has already been deleted. You don't need to do anything else.
photos.dishesText: Show what you cook and say what each dish is. The first photo is the cover in search results. You need at least three to send your profile for review.
photos.emptyText: Good photos, in natural light, are what most makes a client request a booking.

dish.captionPlaceholder: What is this dish? E.g. Traditional duck rice

upload.selfieFailed: The selfie wasn't uploaded. Use a JPG or PNG photo, or take it with the camera.
upload.failed: {count, plural, one {One photo wasn't uploaded} other {# photos weren't uploaded}}. Use JPG, PNG or WEBP.
upload.selfieSent: Selfie sent. Only the team can see it.
upload.uploaded: {count, plural, one {Photo uploaded.} other {# photos uploaded.}}

photos.title: Photos
photos.text: A photo of you and at least three of your dishes, with descriptions.

offer.title: Create an offer
offer.text: A menu, a box or an order, with a price. It's what clients book.

days.title: Open the days you can cook
days.text: Clients can only request a booking on the days you open. You can open the days of the week you usually cook right now.

review.title: Send for review
review.text: The team checks the photos and your profile goes public.
review.seeEmail: see the email we sent you.

billing.title: Invoicing details
billing.text: Legal name, tax number (NIF), tax address, IBAN and the contract. Without these we can collect the deposit for you, but we can't transfer it to you.

setup.headingOnlyBilling: We need your invoicing details to pay you
setup.heading: First steps
setup.waitingText: The team will reply by email. Meanwhile, you can fine-tune your offers and availability.
setup.onlyBillingText: You can already take requests. The deposit clients pay is held for you. We just can't transfer it until we have your tax details, your IBAN and the accepted contract. Nothing is lost: it waits for you.

lumi.label: Lumi's help
lumi.explain: “Just for now” brings her back on your next visit. “Never show again” applies to every page; you can turn her back on whenever you like.
lumi.settingText: Short tips on the dashboard pages until you finish the first steps. You can turn her off at any time.

rejected.title: A few points to review
rejected.text: The team left notes in the last step. Just fix those points and send it again.

resume.title: Pick up where you left off
resume.text: The details you saved are still here. Your public name is how clients know you on Ao Lume: your own name or the name you cook under.

welcome.title: Welcome to Ao Lume
welcome.text: I'm Lumi and I'll guide you, field by field. Your public name is how clients know you on Ao Lume: your own name or the name you cook under.

link.title: Your page's address
link.text: It's the link to your profile, easy to find and to share with clients. It's created from your public name; go for something short and simple.

appear.title: How you want to appear
appear.text: It sets the title on your public profile: cook. With a verified certificate, you'll appear as Chef.

profile.title: Profile type
profile.text: It's shown on your public profile, next to your name: home cook or cooking professional. Choose what best describes your experience.

headline.title: A line about you
headline.text: A quick description of your cooking, which clients read just below your name. For example: Alentejo cooking for dinners at home.

bio.title: Your story in the kitchen
bio.text: Tell how you started, where you learnt, what you like to cook and how you work. It's what introduces the person who'll be cooking in the client's home.

area.title: Where you work
area.text: Enter the area where you want to cook for your clients. Clients only see the area, never your address.

radius.title: How far you travel
radius.text: The distance, in kilometres from your area, you're willing to travel for a service.

social.title: Instagram or website
social.text: It's only so the team can see that you really cook: dishes you've made, events, clients. It doesn't need to be a professional page or have lots of followers; a personal account with photos of your food is enough.

portrait.title: Profile photo
portrait.done: Photo uploaded. You can change it whenever you like.
portrait.todo: It's public: the picture clients see before welcoming you into their home. Go for a sharp photo, facing the camera, in good light.

selfie.title: Verification selfie
selfie.done: Selfie received. Only the team sees it and it's deleted after approval.
selfie.todo: It's private and only the team has access. It confirms the profile photo is you, and it's deleted after approval.

dishes.title: Dish photos
dishes.needThree: You need at least three. They're what most influences a booking request: favour natural light and the dish in focus.
dishes.missing: {count} more to go. They're what most influences a booking request: favour natural light and the dish in focus.
dishes.enough: You have enough photos. The first is the cover in search results; you can reorder them.

continue.title: Photos done
continue.text: You can move on to the last step and send your profile for review.

ready.title: Profile ready for review
ready.text: The team reviews every profile, usually on the same working day. Your tax number (NIF) and IBAN are only asked for before the first payment.

notReady.title: Some things are still missing
notReady.text: Select “Missing” on each item to complete it. Everything you've saved is kept.

weekly.title: Your regular days
weekly.text: Choose the days of the week you usually cook and save: they stay open every week, without having to come back every month.

calendar.title: Your open days
calendar.text: Tap a day to open or close it, for example for a day off or an extra day; it's saved straight away. Clients can only request on open days.

first.title: Create your first offer
first.text: An offer is what clients book: a menu, a box or an order. Start with one, with a clear title and the price.

list.title: Your offers
list.text: You can have several, for different occasions. Untick “Visible on your profile” on the ones you can't do for now.

title.title: Title and description
title.text: A title that says what it is, and in the description the dishes and what's included. It's what helps the client decide.

where.title: Where it's served
where.text: At the client's home, delivered to their address or picked up from your kitchen. Each offer has its own mode.

price.title: How you charge
price.text: Per person or unit, a fixed amount, or on request when every booking is different, for example for events.

hours.title: Times
hours.text: Tap the times you can serve. When requesting, the client picks one of them.

leadTime.title: Notice
leadTime.text: How many hours' notice you need to receive a request. Clients can't request with less notice than that.

categories.title: Cuisine categories
categories.text: Choose up to five: they're how clients find you in search. If your cuisine isn't on the list, you can add it.

services.title: Services you offer
services.text: Only turn on what you actually do. Services appear on your profile and clients filter their search by them.

portrait.title: Your photo
portrait.text: Sharp, facing the camera, in good light. It's the first thing a client sees before welcoming you into their home.

dishes.title: Your dishes
dishes.text: Say what each dish is and put them in order: the first photo is the cover in search results.

quote.title: This request needs a quote
quote.text: The client is waiting for your price. Read the notes, press “Send quote” and enter the total price. If the client accepts, they pay the deposit in the app and the date is secured.
